name: Cube Against Cancer Brisbane 2026
information: **This competition is a part of the [Cube Against Cancer](https://www.cubeagainstcancer.org/) competition series in collaboration with [Ethan's Ohana](https://www.ethansohana.org/). We are asking that all competitors bring at least one unopened 3x3 cube or STEM-related item, which will be donated to a pediatric cancer patient. See the [Cube Against Cancer](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/CubeAgainstCancerBrisbane2026#67602-cube-against-cancer) tab for more information.** ![](https://i.imgur.com/ZIPeEfV.png) **Contact us** We are on [Facebook](https://www.facebook.com/SpeedcubingAustralia/) and [Instagram](https://www.instagram.com/speedcubingau/)! [Speedcubing Australia Website](https://speedcubing.org.au) Speedcubing Australia acknowledges the traditional owners of this land, the Jagera and Turrbal people, and pays respect to the elders, past and present for they hold the memories, the traditions, the culture and hopes of Aboriginal Australia.
